title: Legal Standards / Terms & Conditions / Trademark questions
slide_intent: Explain the distinction between brand recognition and permitted trademark use so teams know which decisions require qualified review.
strategic_value: A question-led reference can help Burger King partners preserve consistent naming and route uncertainty to the company’s legal team.
demonstration: An introductory column explains the role of names and logos, followed by dense question-and-answer columns on trademarks, trade names, infringement, franchisees and territorial symbols.
practical_value: Use the historical FAQ to locate the relevant trademark topic and its referral route; do not treat it as current jurisdictional advice.

content_islands.spec: Place the section title and introductory explanation in the left column.

content_islands.name: Definitions and naming
content_islands.spec: Use the next column for trademark versus trade-name examples and why correct use matters.

content_islands.name: Clearance and infringement
content_islands.spec: Continue the FAQ in the central-right column with proposed-mark clearance and infringement topics.

content_islands.name: Franchisees and symbols
content_islands.spec: Use the far-right column for franchisee restrictions and country-dependent symbol examples.

reference_purposes.Intent: The introduction explicitly links correct names and logos to preserving recognition, strength and identity.
reference_purposes.Application: The FAQ compares trademark and trade-name forms and gives country-dependent designation examples.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source requires clearance of new marks and prior approval of franchisee uses, and directs uncertain cases to the Legal Department.
